card.name: Middle of brand drug names
card.fires_on: The middle chunk of an invented brand name, mostly the 'XF' in ELREXFIO, also 'ELS' in VELSIPITY and 'fp' in sofpironium. It also fires on a broken byte piece inside a Chinese term.

modes.label: ELREXFIO brand name
modes.description: The 'XF' piece in the middle of the brand name ELREXFIO in dosing and warning text.

modes.label: Other brand or generic names
modes.description: A middle piece of another drug name such as VELSIPITY or sofpironium.
modes.example: Prior to First Dose of V<<ELS>>IPITY Before initiation of treatment with V

modes.label: Broken Chinese characters
modes.description: A partial byte piece inside a Chinese Buddhist text title.

card.plain: It marks the middle of an unusual brand drug name, mainly ELREXFIO, where the name is split into pieces.
